report: indication: brain mri: [date]:12 pm clinical history: grade ii astrocytoma with partial resection [date] followed by radiotherapy. comparison: prior mri brain dated [date]. technique: multiple sequences through the brain were acquired at 3.0 tesla. contrast media: intravenous gadolinium chelate was administered for post-contrast imaging. findings: status post right temporal craniotomy with stable linear enhancement in the resection cavity. persistent flair hyperintensity in the adjacent temporal lobe without new enhancement, consistent with gliosis. no evidence of new mass effect or midline shift. ventricular size remains within normal limits. normal signal intensity of the skull base and calvarium. impression: stable post-surgical changes in the right temporal lobe with no evidence of tumor progression. end of impression

indication: brain mri: [date]:15 pm clinical history: newly diagnosed glioblastoma multiforme, biopsy confirmed [date]. comparison: initial mri brain [date]. technique: multiple sequences through the brain were acquired at 1.5 tesla. contrast media: intravenous gadolinium chelate was administered for post-contrast imaging. findings: there is a large enhancing mass in the left frontal lobe with significant surrounding edema and mass effect on the lateral ventricle. midline shift of approximately 5 mm to the right. no evidence of hemorrhage. normal signal intensity of the skull and facial bones. impression: large enhancing left frontal mass consistent with known glioblastoma, with associated mass effect and midline shift. end of impression
